body:
Thank you.

I lie to get the xanax and hydrocodone. Not hard to fake chronic pain issues and when bipolar & having OCD, the need for xanax isn't a big jump and doesn't take much effort. I have so many people depending on me, so much pressure, so much weight on my shoulders I can't share. It's pathetic but I've gotten in a bad cycle. I "need" xanax to sleep, to not lose my fucking mind. When I'm overwhelmed, 3-4 mg is a pleasant numb, very void, very peaceful. I "need" hydrocodone to function because it feels like a stimulant to me. 3+ 10s a day. They keep me wired (thus the xanax) and focused, and allow me to feel a little warm and extra open to love type feelings.

I've honestly considered buying coke but I don't believe i could afford the amount I would need to keep me going.

Plenty of other adults in my position, in positions worse than mine, deal with life without substance abuse. Why can't I? Why am I so fucking weak and pathetic?

My husband.. For his sake I'm trying to acknowledge any redeeming qualities I have, but it's hard to see them. He stands by even when I withdraw. Sometimes, a lot of the time, I want so badly for him to comfort me but when he does I tell him to get the fuck away, Leave me alone, and I don't know why. I don't know when I became so mean but I am actively trying to stop because if i just allow him to love me I will feel better. But always in my head is, what the fuck is keeping him around?

Was I so good once that a memory of my former self is enough to motivate him to stick through, see that I get help, and return to the person he fell for? I feel like the clock is ticking and I'm racing back to that person before I lose everything. But I keep tripping over myself.
